data.config.yaml:
healthCheckTimeout: 900
logToStdout: both
apiKeys:
- ${env.LLAMA_API_TOKEN}
# HyperQwen is the resident text model (Strata/Swift decommissioned 2026-11-01):
# load it at startup so the first request does not pay the ~5 min cold boot.
hooks:
  on_startup:
    preload:
    - qwen3.8-27b-hyperqwen
models:
  qwen3.8-27b-hyperqwen:
    name: qwen3.8-27b-hyperqwen
    ttl: 0
    # DFlash k7, full reasoning and 200K context: optimization/larger-context/.
    # PTH_FA=1 keeps int8 per-token-head KV on pth-flash-attn (CUSTOM backend).
    # 7.25 GiB KV and frozen embedding offload match the qualified context trial.
    # Fair chunked prefill keeps short requests responsive beside a long prefill.
    # 16GiB CPU prefix tier preserves long sessions across GPU-cache eviction.
    # PIECEWISE is required: the full-graph/offload profile looped on a coding control.
    # Historical E1 (2026-11-03) results in optimization/research/ qualified MTP,
    # not this DFlash configuration. Four admissions share the KV pool.
    # INT8_ACT on MLP linears as qualified 2026-10-30 (TTFT -18%, quality matched).
    # Weights in /app/models (hyperqwen-bakeoff); runtime is HyperQwen 2cf50a0 in this image.
    # INT8 lm_head build, not -fast (INT4 head): PPL -0.5%, same decode/TTFT, 2026-11-10;
    # optimization/research/all-angles-2026-11-09.md.
    # Fixed port (outside llama-swap's auto range from 5800) so the vllm-metrics
    # sidecar can read /metrics without going through llama-swap.
    cmd: /usr/bin/env PORT=5890 /app/venv/bin/python -I -S /chat-template/start_qwen_cache.py
    proxy: http://127.0.0.1:5890
    useModelName: qwen3.8-27b
    # start_qwen_cache.py (cmd above) checks these env values against its own
    # required set and exits on any mismatch; keep both in sync.
    env:
    - MODEL=/app/models/Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound
    - SPEC=dflash2
    - CTX=long
    - INT8_ACT=int8
    - INT8_LAYERS=mlp
    - MAX_SEQS=4
    - VISION=1
    - PTH_FA=1
    - FA2_FP8KV=0
    - PTH_CPU_CACHE=1
    - KV_OFFLOAD_GB=16
    - PREFIX_RETENTION=5184
    - CUDAGRAPH_MODE=PIECEWISE
    - EXTRA_ARGS=--chat-template /chat-template/chat_template.jinja --long-prefill-token-threshold 864 --long-prefill-token-threshold-adaptive --watermark 0.1
    - VISION_OFFLOAD=1
    - PREFIX_CACHE=1
    - HOST=127.0.0.1
    - XDG_CACHE_HOME=/cache
    - HF_HOME=/cache/huggingface
    - HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
    - PYTHONPATH=
    - &vllm-path PATH=/app/venv/bin:/usr/local/nvidia/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    - VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1
    - DO_NOT_TRACK=1
    - DFLASH_TOKENS=7
    - LOOKUP=1
    - DFLASH_MAX_LEN=200000
    - KV_MEM=7784628224
    - EMBED_UVA=1
    metadata:
      max_model_len: 200000
      max_tokens: 32768
      reasoning: true
      input:
      - text
      - image
  qwen3.8-27b-uncensored:
    name: qwen3.8-27b-uncensored
    # On-demand abliterated Qwen3.8-27B retains its original MTP decoding on
    # the same vLLM stack (not preloaded). Requesting it evicts
    # HyperQwen; the next HyperQwen request reloads it (about 5 minutes cold).
    # Weights: leminkozey/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-W4A16-AutoRound (abliterated
    # JonathanColetti/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored, AutoRound W4A16 body, int8 heads, ships
    # without prepare/), downloaded to /srv/llama-nvme/hyperqwen-bakeoff/models/ by hand,
    # see README "Uncensored model".
    cmd: /usr/bin/env PORT=5891 MODEL=/app/models/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-W4A16-AutoRound /bin/bash /app/single-user/start_qwen.sh
    proxy: http://127.0.0.1:5891
    useModelName: qwen3.8-27b
    ttl: 600
    # The weights' own template raises on any reasoning_effort outside
    # xhigh/medium/low, and vLLM always passes the value (None when the
    # request omits it), so most client effort values would fail the
    # request. Serve the effort-translation copy instead: same v2 mapping
    # as the HyperQwen template (minimal -> low, high/max -> xhigh, omitted
    # -> the xhigh default, "none" -> thinking off). See
    # chat_template_uncensored.jinja and README "Uncensored model".
    env:
    - EXTRA_ARGS=--chat-template /chat-template/chat_template_uncensored.jinja
    - SPEC=mtp
    - CTX=long
    - INT8_ACT=int8
    - INT8_LAYERS=mlp
    - MAX_SEQS=4
    - VISION=1
    - PTH_FA=1
    - VISION_OFFLOAD=1
    - PREFIX_CACHE=1
    # Qualified 200K profile: preserve packed embeddings in pinned host RAM.
    - MAX_LEN=200000
    - KV_MEM=7784628224
    - EMBED_UVA=1
    - HOST=127.0.0.1
    - XDG_CACHE_HOME=/cache
    - HF_HOME=/cache/huggingface
    - HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
    - PYTHONPATH=
    - *vllm-path
    - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    - VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1
    - DO_NOT_TRACK=1
    capabilities:
      in:
      - text
      - image
      out:
      - text
      disableAuto: true
    metadata:
      max_model_len: 200000
      max_tokens: 32768
      reasoning: true
      input:
      - text
      - image
  qwen-image-2.1-turbo:
    name: qwen-image-2.1-turbo
    # Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo (8-step schedule) behind an OpenAI images API, with
    # the PE-T2I / PE-I2I prompt enhancers. See qwen-image/README.md.
    cmd: /opt/qwen-image/venv/bin/python /opt/qwen-image/server.py --port ${PORT}
      --served-name qwen-image-2.1-turbo --model /models/qwen-image/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo
      --pe-t2i /models/qwen-image/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I --pe-i2i /models/qwen-image/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-I2I
    env: &qwen-image-env
    - HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
    - PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
    # Free the card for the text models after ten idle minutes.
    ttl: 600
    aliases:
    - qwen-image
    capabilities: &qwen-image-capabilities
      in:
      - text
      - image
      out:
      - image
      disableAuto: true
  qwen-image-2.1:
    name: qwen-image-2.1
    # Base Qwen-Image-2.1 at 40 steps: slower than Turbo, for quality.
    cmd: /opt/qwen-image/venv/bin/python /opt/qwen-image/server.py --port ${PORT}
      --served-name qwen-image-2.1 --model /models/qwen-image/Qwen-Image-2.1 --default-steps 40
      --pe-t2i /models/qwen-image/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I --pe-i2i /models/qwen-image/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-I2I
    env: *qwen-image-env
    ttl: 600
    capabilities: *qwen-image-capabilities
  glm-ocr-baseline: &glm-ocr-baseline
    name: GLM-OCR private comparison
    # Fixed local artifacts; no downloader, hosted API or financial actions.
    # ggml-org/GLM-OCR-GGUF revision 65a42de1148dbed2297e922b5dbc7d9b70c36578; F16 model/Q8_0 projector.
    cmd: /opt/llama/llama-server --model /models/glm-ocr-baseline/GLM-OCR-f16.gguf --mmproj /models/glm-ocr-baseline/mmproj-GLM-OCR-Q8_0.gguf --alias glm-ocr-baseline --ctx-size 24576 --parallel 1 --n-gpu-layers 999 --threads 2 --threads-batch 2 --jinja --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${PORT} --temp 0 --top-p 1 --n-predict 4096 --no-context-shift
    env:
    - LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/llama:/opt/llama/cuda:/usr/local/nvidia/lib64:/usr/local/nvidia/lib
    ttl: 300
    unlisted: true
    capabilities:
      in:
      - image
      out:
      - text
      disableAuto: true
  glm-ocr-hires:
    <<: *glm-ocr-baseline
    name: GLM-OCR high resolution private comparison
    # Same artifacts as glm-ocr-baseline with a larger image token budget.
    cmd: /opt/llama/llama-server --model /models/glm-ocr-baseline/GLM-OCR-f16.gguf --mmproj /models/glm-ocr-baseline/mmproj-GLM-OCR-Q8_0.gguf --alias glm-ocr-hires --image-max-tokens 12288 --ctx-size 24576 --parallel 1 --n-gpu-layers 999 --threads 2 --threads-batch 2 --jinja --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${PORT} --temp 0 --top-p 1 --n-predict 4096 --no-context-shift
  paddleocr-vl-official:
    name: PaddleOCR official pipeline private comparison
    # Same pinned Paddle weights/runtime as the durable finance provider.
    # GPU ownership stays with this manager; CPU layout runs in a separate bounded job.
    # This is synchronous inference only, not the finance durable OCR API.
    cmd: /usr/bin/env -i -C /opt/finance-ocr PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin HOME=/tmp TMPDIR=/tmp LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/py312/lib:/usr/local/nvidia/lib64:/usr/local/nvidia/lib NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PADDLE_PDX_DISABLE_MODEL_SOURCE_CHECK=True PADDLE_PDX_MODEL_SOURCE=HuggingFace VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 OCR_ENABLED=real OCR_RUNTIME_MANIFEST=/etc/ocr/manifest.json /opt/ocr/venv-vllm/bin/python services/ocr/deploy/run_vllm.py
    proxy: http://127.0.0.1:8000
    useModelName: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6-0.9B
    ttl: 900
    unlisted: true
    capabilities:
      in:
      - image
      out:
      - text
      disableAuto: true
  finance-ocr-glm:
    name: Finance OCR GLM private candidate
    # Separate durable queue/API. Existing Paddle source, manifest and history stay intact.
    cmd: /usr/bin/python3 /opt/finance-ocr-glm/services/ocr/deploy/launch_glm.py --port ${PORT}
    env:
    - OCR_TOKEN_FILE=/run/secrets/ocr/token
    - OCR_NAMESPACE=finance-ocr-synthetic-trial
    - OCR_DATA_DIR=/ocr-data/glm
    ttl: 900
    unlisted: true
    capabilities:
      in:
      - image
      out:
      - text
      disableAuto: true
  paddleocr-vl:
    name: paddleocr-vl
    # Finance OCR: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 on a private vLLM, PP-DocLayoutV3 layout and a
    # durable async job API (POST /v1/ocr/jobs, then poll). It is not an OpenAI
    # model: call it through /upstream/paddleocr-vl/v1/ocr/..., with the OCR
    # service token as well as the llama bearer token. See ocr/README.md.
    cmd: /usr/bin/python3 /opt/ocr/launch.py --port ${PORT}
    env:
    - OCR_RUNTIME_MANIFEST=/etc/ocr/manifest.json
    - OCR_TOKEN_FILE=/run/secrets/ocr/token
    - OCR_NAMESPACE=finance-ocr-synthetic-trial
    - OCR_DATA_DIR=/ocr-data
    # Polls and uploads reset the idle clock; this only has to outlast one job (300s).
    ttl: 900
    unlisted: true
    capabilities:
      in:
      - image
      out:
      - text
      disableAuto: true
